grades.reason: All literal requested parts are accurate and resolved. Exact application: "The defender may play a matching ambush (birds wild); the attacker may foil with a matching ambush. If no attacking warriors or pawns remain, battle ends immediately; ambush hits are not limited by defending warriors. Resolve before-roll effects (attacker orders them if both sides have effects), roll (higher die is attacker hits and lower defender hits, equal dice equal results; each side’s rolled hits are capped by its own warriors, with Alliance defending reversing dice and Vagabond using undamaged swords instead of warriors), then after-roll effects (attacker orders effects if both sides have them). Count hits by adding extra hits and subtracting ignored hits; if defender has no warriors, attacker adds one defenseless hit (for Vagabond, defenseless means no undamaged swords). Each hit removes one opposing piece. The side taking hits chooses removal order but must remove all its warriors before its buildings/tokens, and orders its own removal-trigger effects. Both sides deal counted hits; later warrior losses do not change rolled-hit caps. A player removing an enemy building or token scores one VP each, even while defending and outside battle; Vagabond takes hits as item damage. For simultaneous removal effects, remove all pieces before triggering those effects."
